name: substack-article-mcp
description: Access your Substack articles, comments, and engagement data — including paid/premium content.
long_description:
Read articles from any Substack newsletter you subscribe to, directly from Claude. Get full article content (including paywalled posts), comment threads, engagement metrics, and search across publications.

**Setup:** After installing, run `npx -y substack-article-mcp login` once in your terminal to authenticate with Substack. This opens a Chrome window where you log in — your main Chrome stays untouched.

**Tools included:**
- **list_articles** — Browse recent articles from any newsletter
- **get_article** — Full article content as markdown (premium included)
- **get_comments** — Complete comment tree with replies and reactions
- **search_articles** — Search by keyword across any publication
